usedFor: Sellsy holds invoices, opportunities and companies, and Freshsales Classic keeps the deal that “Update Deal” changes from “Updated Opportunity Status”.

bestTemplate.name: “Updated Opportunity Status” in Sellsy, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A status change in Sellsy carries over to the deal, and the action can update its stage, amount or probability.

watchOut: “Update Deal” locates the deal by ID or name, so “Updated Opportunity Status” must hand over one that matches.
